verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity's Verification Flows let teams save a verification configuration, reuse it across integration interfaces, and send users a static link. That is a thin, first-party form of reusable template configuration. The evidence does not say flows are edited without code or that changes take effect without a deploy, and it shows no conditional logic, routing or per-country rules. Missing for 10: conditional/branching steps, risk-based routing, country-specific requirement rules, explicit no-code editing of flows with changes live without an engineering deploy, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can configure verification logic without code — conditional steps, risk-based routing, country-specific requirements, and template changes that don't need an engineering deploy

citations.quote: Flows provide a way to save and reuse the same configuration across all of your integration interfaces.
You can use a flow’s static link to verify any number of your users.
